name: Nvidia Telemetry
optimize_description: Sends Nvidia anonymous statistics about how the Shield is used. Disabling stops those reports and changes nothing else on the device.
restore_description: Lets the Shield send anonymous usage statistics to Nvidia again.

name: Nvidia Diagnostics
optimize_description: Nvidia's built-in log collector — what support asks you to run when you file a ticket. Disabling costs you nothing unless you are working through one.
restore_description: Puts Nvidia's diagnostic log collector back for support tickets.

name: Nvidia Feedback
optimize_description: Collects crash reports and the “send feedback” forms Nvidia ships on the Shield. Disabling stops the reports; playback, apps and updates are unaffected.
restore_description: Restores Nvidia's crash-report and feedback collection.

name: Sponsored Content
optimize_description: Removes Sponsored / Top Picks rows on the stock Google TV home. Also removes the home-screen Watch Next rows that surface Apple TV / Netflix Continue Watching. No effect if you've switched to a custom launcher.
restore_description: Restores sponsored and Watch Next rows on stock launcher.

name: Nvidia OSC
optimize_description: Draws Nvidia's on-screen overlay — the panel that appears over a game showing streaming, controller and performance status for Nvidia Games and GameStream. Disabling removes that overlay; normal apps, video and games are untouched, so keep it only if you still use Nvidia Games.
restore_description: Brings back Nvidia's on-screen game overlay.

name: Nvidia System Hooks
optimize_description: Shield system hooks — remaps the Xbox controller Guide button to Home. Disabling fixes Guide button conflicts in Steam Link and Moonlight.
restore_description: Restores Shield system hooks (Xbox Guide → Home remapping).

name: Nvidia Games (Tegra Zone)
optimize_description: Nvidia's own games storefront and home-screen row, built around the GameStream service Nvidia retired in 2023. Disabling removes the Nvidia Games app and its row; GeForce NOW and Play Store games keep working.
restore_description: Brings back the Nvidia Games app and its home-screen row.

name: Nvidia GameStream
optimize_description: The GameStream server that let a gaming PC stream to this Shield. Nvidia shut the service down in 2023, so it no longer connects to anything — Moonlight and Sunshine are separate and unaffected.

name: Nvidia System Updater
optimize_description: Downloads and installs Shield system updates. Disabling stops the device updating itself at all, security fixes included — only do this if you are deliberately staying on this firmware.
restore_description: Lets the Shield download and install system updates again.

name: Google Speech Services
optimize_description: Google's on-device speech recognition — the part that turns what you say into text. Disabling breaks voice dictation and every in-app mic button, SmartTube's included.
restore_description: Restores on-device speech recognition and the mic buttons that use it.

name: Plex Media Server
optimize_description: The Plex server built into the Shield, which shares media from attached drives to your other devices. Disabling stops this TV serving media; the Plex app you watch with is a separate package and keeps working.
restore_description: Re-enables the Shield's built-in Plex media server.

name: Stock Launcher
optimize_description: The stock Android TV home screen. Disabling it with no other launcher active leaves the TV with nowhere to land on Home — install and set a replacement on the Launcher tab first.
restore_description: Restores the stock Android TV home screen.
